scope_differences: User correction (createCorrection) is designed here because UX-003 deferred correction to P7-WP5; the accepted API places it on no UX-001 surface, so its placement is recorded here and UX-001 is unchanged.
Re-analysis reuses createEvaluations (owned for the initial evaluation by UX-002) only with a predecessor evaluation and a reason; UX-002 is unchanged.
Historical comparison has no accepted API capability, so the design presents separate, source-labelled records and computes no comparison.

recovery_vocabulary.meaning: Repeat the same read, or resend the same command with the same idempotency key.
Repeat later, honouring any returned Retry-After; no countdown is invented.
The same command is still being processed; wait and resend it unchanged with the same key.
Read the authoritative Evaluation state before choosing a presentation.
Correct the request before any new attempt; field values are not echoed.
Reload the current state and its ETag, show what changed and let the person decide again; never overwrite silently.
The key was used for a different command; review the intended action and submit it as a new command.
Do not retry; show the governed state only.

state_labels.label: Generating
state_labels.meaning: The report is being generated from its pinned sources; nothing is ready yet.

state_labels.label: Ready
state_labels.meaning: The report was generated from its pinned sources.

state_labels.label: Generation failed
state_labels.meaning: The report could not be generated.

state_labels.label: Integrity check failed
state_labels.meaning: The report content did not pass its integrity check and is withheld.

state_labels.label: Cannot be regenerated
state_labels.meaning: A pinned source is no longer available, so the report cannot be reproduced; nothing is approximated.

state_labels.label: Removed under governance
state_labels.meaning: The report was removed through governed deletion; it is not recreated.

content.pre_access_notice: Downloading this report is recorded in the audit log.

state_labels.label: Replay pending
state_labels.meaning: The replay was accepted and has not finished; no outcome is implied.

state_labels.label: Replay finished
state_labels.meaning: The replay finished with the outcome shown.

outcome_labels.label: Reproduced exactly
outcome_labels.meaning: Replaying the pinned material produced the recorded result digest.

outcome_labels.label: Did not reproduce
outcome_labels.meaning: Replaying the pinned material produced a different digest; the recorded result is unchanged.

outcome_labels.label: Replay unavailable: material missing
outcome_labels.meaning: Required pinned material is missing, so the evaluation cannot be replayed.

outcome_labels.label: Replay unavailable: integrity failure
outcome_labels.meaning: Pinned material failed its integrity check, so the evaluation cannot be replayed.

outcome_labels.label: Replay unavailable: engine unavailable
outcome_labels.meaning: The pinned engine version is not available for replay.

outcome_labels.label: Replay unavailable: knowledge bundle unavailable
outcome_labels.meaning: The pinned knowledge bundle is not available for replay.

reanalysis.notice: A new analysis creates a new evaluation. Earlier evaluations and results are kept unchanged.

correction.notice: Your correction creates a new evaluation. The earlier evaluation and its result are kept unchanged.

state_labels.label: Requested
state_labels.meaning: The request was recorded and awaits an administrator decision; nothing has been removed.

state_labels.label: Authorized
state_labels.meaning: An administrator authorized the request; removal has not started.

state_labels.label: In progress
state_labels.meaning: Governed removal is running; it is not finished.

state_labels.label: Removal complete
state_labels.meaning: Governed removal finished for the requested scope.

state_labels.label: Partly failed
state_labels.meaning: Governed removal covered only part of the scope; it is not complete.

state_labels.label: Rejected
state_labels.meaning: An administrator rejected the request; nothing was removed.

review_findings.summary: Security-critical display labels were not governed: REQUESTED and AUTHORIZED could read as completed removal, a removed report as not found, and a replay outcome could claim current-engine substitution
Deletion authorization and rejection were offered for any visible request: a rejection was offered and issued for a COMPLETE request
Re-raised MEDIUM-1: replay-state labels were ungoverned (a PENDING replay could read as completed successfully), and an explicit denial of current-engine substitution was wrongly rejected
